evapotranspiration.label: evapotranspiration
evapotranspiration.explanation: Water that leaves the field as vapour, from the soil surface and through the leaves of the plants.

anomaly.label: anomaly
anomaly.explanation: How far this year or month is above or below what is usual for this field at that time of year.

ndvi.label: NDVI
ndvi.explanation: A satellite reading of how green and dense the plants on a field are: low over bare soil, close to 1 over a thick crop.

soil-moisture.label: soil moisture (m³/m³)
soil-moisture.explanation: How much water the soil holds, as water volume per soil volume, so 0.30 means water fills 30% of the soil.

root-zone.label: root zone
root-zone.explanation: The layer of soil that crop roots reach and take water from, which in our data is the top metre of soil.

soil-wetness-index.label: soil wetness index
soil-wetness-index.explanation: How wet the top metre of soil is, from 0 when completely dry to 1 when full of water, as estimated by NASA POWER.

suitability-class.label: suitability class
suitability-class.explanation: A rating from an FAO crop model of how well a crop suits the local climate, soil and land, from very high to not suitable.

cover-crop.label: cover crop
cover-crop.explanation: A crop grown to cover and protect the soil between main crops, not to sell, for example clover or rye over winter.

catch-crop.label: catch crop
catch-crop.explanation: A fast-growing crop sown right after harvest to take up leftover nitrogen before rain washes it away and to cover bare soil.

humus-balance.label: humus balance
humus-balance.explanation: Our estimate of whether a rotation builds up the soil's organic matter or runs it down, from the crops, soil type and weather.

percentile-range.label: percentile range
percentile-range.explanation: A low and a high value that most years or soil samples fall between, leaving out the few most extreme cases at each end.

model-estimate.label: model estimate
model-estimate.explanation: A value worked out by a computer model from satellite and weather data, not measured on your field, so the real value may differ.

margin.label: margin
margin.explanation: Crop sales per hectare minus direct costs such as seed, fertiliser, sprays and fuel, before land, labour, machinery ownership and payments.

government-support.label: government support
government-support.explanation: Money a government agency pays per hectare each year, if you apply, for practices that protect soil and water, such as cover crops.
